source: 539 Information on the Sea Prayer Ritual
target: 539 Notitia de Ritu Orationis Maritimae

source: In Port Santa, inside a room featuring a lone card table,
target: In Porto Santa, intra conclave quod mensam unicam ludorum cartarum habebat,

source: Lumian and Lugano, their appearances altered and attire changed, met the black‐market merchant claiming lineage to Dariège.
target: Lumian et Lugano, quorum specie mutata et vestitu commissato erant, convenere cum mercatore clandestino qui originem Dariège affirmabat.

source: Seated at the head of the table, he sported a white shirt and a black vest, a glass of pale malt‐colored white wine at his fingertips and a slowly burning cigar between them.
target: Consedit in capite mensae, gerens camisiam albi et vestem nigram, habens poculum vini albi pallidi colore malto in digitis suis et cigarum lente ardentem inter ea.

source: He did embody the heritage of the Dariège region with slightly sunken eye sockets, slightly curled black hair, and piercing blue eyes reminiscent of a cloudless sky over a towering mountain.
target: Ipse repraesentabat hereditatem regionis Dariège, cum orbibus paulo deprimis, capillis nigris modice crispatis, et oculis caeruleis acutis, qui similes erant caelo sine nubibus super montem excelsum.

source: His thin cheeks and thick stubble suggested a man in his thirties.
target: Genæ eius tenuæ et barba spissa indicabant virum triginta annos natus.

source: “Good afternoon, Mr. Valerio,” Lugano greeted in Highlander.
target: «Bonum postmeridie, domine Valerio,» salutavit Lugano in lingua Highlander.

source: Valerio, casting a glance at his armed bodyguards, responded with a smile in Intisian, flavored with a distinct Dariège accent.
target: Valerio, custodios armatos conspiciens, respondit cum risu in Intisian mixto distincto accentu Dariège.

source: “It’s been a long time since I’ve returned home.
target: «Iamdudum est ex quo domum redii.

source: It’s a pleasure to see you.”
target: Gaudium est te videre.»

source: “Indeed, Mr. Valerio,” Lumian replied in Intisian, his voice also tinged with a Dariège accent.
target: «Revera, domine Valerio,» respondit Lumian in Intisian, voxque eius quoque notata accentu Dariège.

source: While shepherds excelled at navigating the perils of the wilderness, an inherent wariness of authorities in settled human areas lingered.
target: Dum pastores pericula solitudinis navigare perite utebantur, innata tamen timor erga auctoritates in sedibus humanis permanebat.

source: Valerio nodded subtly and inquired, “Did you come from Larnaca?”
target: Valerio submisse annuit et quaesivit, «Venistine ex Larnaca?»

source: “Yes, I just finished attending the trade fair there,” Lumian replied smoothly.
target: «Ita, modo feria mercaturae ibi peracta est,» respondit Lumian leniter.

source: Having learned about Larnaca from the shepherds in Cordu, Lumian was well aware of the monthly trade fair that transformed the suburbs into a bustling marketplace.
target: Ex pastoribus Corduinis de Larnaca discens, Lumian bene sciebat feriam mercaturae menstruam quae suburbia in forum vivum converteret.

source: Shepherds from far and wide flocked to the event, seizing opportunities to trade lamb, wool, cheese, and other goods.
target: Pastores ex longinquo congregati sunt, occasiones arripientes ad mercandum agnum, lanam, caseum, aliaque bona.

source: Valerio then delved into the topic of migration and Dariège’s folklore.
target: Deinde Valerio in thema migrationis et fabularum Dariège disseruit.

source: Lumian, well-versed in the subject from a shepherd’s perspective, provided insightful answers.
target: Lumian, ex prospectu pastoris bene instructus, responsa perspicua dedit.

source: In the midst of the conversation, he felt a bit disoriented.
target: In media colloquio paulo confusus se sensit.

source: Recollections of his sister’s occasional threats echoed in his mind: “If you don’t study hard, I’ll send you off to be a shepherd!”
target: Memoria minarum sororis occasionalium in animo suo resonabat: “Nisi diligenter studes, te ad pastorem mittam!”

source: Now, irony had it that he found himself playing the role of a shepherd.
target: Iam ironice se in munere pastoris agere invenit.

source: After some time, Valerio nodded in satisfaction and took a puff of his cigar.
target: Post aliquod tempus, Valerio laetus annuit et cigarum suum inspiravit.

source: “You’re quite wise.
target: «Valde sapiens es.

source: Grazing in the suburbs doesn’t require identification, but settling in the city requires it.
target: Pascendi in suburbis identificatio non requiritur, sed sedes in urbe id postulatur.

source: I’ll get you two sets as soon as possible.
target: Mox tibi duas copias procurabo.

source: In the future, if you encounter any difficulties, you can come to me.
target: In futurum, si difficultates occurrant, ad me venire potes.

source: I might not be of much help, but having one more person will give you more ideas.
target: Fortasse non multum auxiliabor, sed una persona addita tibi plura consilia conferet.

source: We’re all from Dariège, so we naturally have to have each other’s backs.”
target: Omnes ex Dariège sumus, ergo invicem sustentare debemus.

source: Lumian wasn’t surprised by the black‐market merchant’s enthusiasm.
target: Lumian non miratus est de alacritate mercatoris clandestini.

source: Uniting the people of one’s homeland would create an exploitable force that couldn’t be ignored!
target: Populum patriae unire vires expoliabiles crearet, quas non neglegere possis!

source: It was reminiscent of the Savoie Mob.
target: Hoc simile erat Savoie Catervae.

source: In the beginning, the pioneers, mostly Savoyards working as laborers and attendants, paved the way for the big bosses of the Savoie Chamber of Commerce.
target: Initio, pioneeri, plerumque Savoyenses laborantes ut operarii et ministri, viam sternuerunt ingentibus ducibus Camarae Commercii Savoie.

source: They expanded operations, safeguarded assets, and contributed immeasurably.
target: Operas dilataverunt, bona tueri curaverunt, et incommensurabiliter contulerunt.

source: As for how many Savoyards might end up living a less than honest life or end up dead on the streets, the wealthy merchants turned a blind eye.
target: Quot Savoyenses vitam non honeste agere aut in viis mori poterunt, divites mercatores indifferenter respexerunt.

source: Lumian applied the acting techniques learned from Jenna and Anthony Reid’s guidance to commend Valerio’s noble character.
target: Lumian technicas agendi, quas a Jenna et Anthony Reid didicerat, ad laudandum nobilem Valerio ingenium adhibuit.

source: With a smile, Valerio offered a piece of advice.
target: Subrisu, Valerio aliquod consilium obtulit.

source: “If you want to survive here, it’s best to convert to Earth Mother as soon as possible.
target: «Si hic superesse vis, optime est quam primum ad Matrem Terram converteris.

source: Find a good lady to marry and have a few children as soon as possible.
target: Bene mulierem quaere, quam in matrimonium ducas, et quam primum paucos liberos habeas.

source: Only then will you avoid hidden trouble.”
target: Tunc tantum evitabīs insidias occultas.»

source: Is urging marriage and childbearing a tradition in the Feynapotter Kingdom?
target: Estne suadere matrimonium et procreationem traditionem in Regno Feynapotter?

source: Lumian criticized and smiled bitterly.
target: Lumian reprehendit et amarissime subrisit.

source: “Without copper coins, there won’t be any good girls.”
target: «Sine nummis cupreis, bonae puellae non erunt.»

source: This Dariège proverb echoed in the room, signifying the difficulty for the poor, especially shepherds, to attract fine ladies and start families.
target: Hoc proverbium Dariège in conclave resonabat, significans difficultatem pauperum, praesertim pastorum, ut pulchras feminas attrahant et familias constituant.

source: “This is Feynapotter, not Dariège,” Valerio remarked, taking a sip of his white wine.
target: «Hoc est Feynapotter, non Dariège,» inquit Valerio, dum poculum vini albi degustabat.

source: “The good ladies here value robust bodies and bravery.
target: «Hae bonae feminae hic corpora robusta et fortitudinem aestimant.

source: The money can wait after you get married.”
target: Post matrimonium pecunia exspectari potest.»

source: Perplexed, Lumian questioned, “Why?
target: Perplexus, Lumian quaesivit, «Cur?

source: “Men like that are more suited for reproduction, and they possess the ability to impregnate good ladies,” Valerio explained with a smile.
target: «Homines tale idonei sunt ad procreationem, et facultatem habent bonas feminas fecundandi,» explicavit Valerio subrisu.

source: “This place is different from Dariège.
target: «Hoc locum a Dariège differt,

source: The essence of many things lies in fertility and reproduction.
target: essentia multarum rerum in fertilitate et procreatione iacet.

source: Only by understanding this can you truly understand Feynapotter and praise the mother of all things!”
target: Solum hoc intellegendo vere possis Feynapotter intellegere et matrem omnium rerum laudare!”

source: The black‐market merchant rose, spreading his feet slightly and raising his hands high.
target: Mercator clandestinus surrexit, pedes paulo diffundens et manus alte levans.

source: No wonder Feynapotter teems with people in the Northern Continent.
target: Non mirum quod Feynapotter abundet hominibus in Continente Septentrionali.

source: Without their knack for land improvement and food cultivation, sustaining such a population would be impossible.
target: Sine arte terrae emendationis et agriculturae, talem populum sustentare impossibile esset.

source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he probed, “Mr. Valerio, I heard there’s a sea prayer ritual next month.
target: Lumiani cogitationes celeriter erant, dum percontabatur: “Domine Valerio, audivi ritu orationis maritimae mense proximo esse.

source: Any chance to make some money?”
target: Num occasio pecuniam faciendi sit?”

source: “Yes,” Valerio replied, taking a seat.
target: «Ita,» respondit Valerio, consedens.

source: “Port Santa stays relatively warm in November.
target: «Porto Santa in Novembri relative calidum est,

source: When my grandfather first came, he rented a wooden box to store popsicles, gathered a pile of ice from the factory, and covered them up.
target: Cum avus meus primum venit, arcam ligneam locavit ad conservanda gelata, glaciei moles ex fabrica collegit et ea operuit.

source: Then, he waded into the crowd, selling popsicles and ice cubes, earning his first bucket of gold.
target: Deinde in turbam ingrediens, gelata et cubos glaciei vendens, primam situlam auri adeptus est.

source: You can still do it now, but the competition is fiercer.
target: Nunc id facere potes, sed certatio vehementior est.

source: You might even need to rent a bicycle for a larger thermal wooden box to hit more ritual venues.”
target: Forsitan etiam birota conducere opus erit, ad ampliorem arcam ligneam thermalem ad plura loca rituum ascendenda.

source: “Many ritual venues?” Lumian asked.
target: «Multa loca rituum?» quaesivit Lumian.

source: Valerio replied with a smile, “This is a grand event for all of Port Santa.
target: Valerio, subrīdens, respondit: “Hoc magnum eventum est pro omni Porto Santa,

source: Different processes happen in various places.
target: Processūs diversi in variis locis fiunt.

source: There’s the Dance of the Sea at the port, a parade of flower boats across the city, a sea boat race, the vigil ritual in Milo Village, and the core sea sacrifice.”
target: Hic est Saltatio Maris ad portum, pompa navium floriferarum per urbem, certamen naviculorum maritimorum, rituum vigiliae in vico Milo, et sacrificium maris principale.”

source: “What’s the sea sacrifice?” Lumian inquired curiously.
target: «Quid est sacrificium maris?» quaesivit Lumian curiosus.

source: Valerio slowly shook his head.
target: Valerio caput negavit.

source: “I don’t know the specifics.
target: «Nescio singula.

source: All I know is that the Governor of the Sea and the Maidens of the Sea board a special boat, head to a certain area beyond the port with sacrifices from fishermen and sea merchants, and perform a unique ritual.
target: Omne quod scio est quod Gubernator Maris et Puellae Maris in navem specialem ascendunt, ad locum certum ultra portum cum sacrificiis piscatorum atque mercatorum maritimorum pergunt, atque singularem ritum faciunt.

source: The detailed process is known only to those who’ve been there.”
target: Processus exactus solum eis notus est, qui ibi fuerunt.”

source: “The Governor of the Sea, the Maidens of the Sea?” Lumian kept picking keywords.
target: «Gubernator Maris, Puellae Maris?» iterum verba clavis evocabat Lumian.

source: This perfectly aligned with the situation of a Dariège shepherd who had just arrived in Port Santa.
target: Hoc perfecte congruebat cum re pastoris Dariège, qui modo in Porto Santa advenerat.

source: Valerio smiled and said, “The crucial part of the Sea Prayer Ritual is selecting a man as the Governor of the Sea and four girls as the Maidens of the Sea.
target: Valerio subrisus dixit, «Pars crucialis Ritu Orationis Maritimae est eligere virum ut Gubernatorem Maris et quattuor puellas ut Puellae Maris.

source: They’ll lead a parade through the city on a flower boat before boarding a special fishing boat at the port.
target: Eos ducent pompa per urbem in navicula florum ornata, antequam in navem piscandi specialem ad portum ascendant.

source: Sailing during the Dance of the Sea, they signal the start of the race.
target: Navigantes dum Saltatio Maris agitur, initium certaminis significant.

source: Later, they circle the port, entering the oldest local fishing village, Milo, for a night.
target: Postea portum circumeunt, intrantes in veterrimum vicum piscatorium localem, Milo, per noctem.

source: At 7 a.m. the next morning, they reboard the boat and head to the sea sacrificial ground with the offerings.”
target: Hora septima matutina diei sequente, navem iterum conscendunt ac ad locum sacrificii maris cum oblationibus properant.

source: The chosen Governor of the Sea and the Maidens of the Sea… A sea prayer ritual with multiple segments… Lumian repeated the key parts inwardly.
target: Elegit Gubernator Maris et Puellae Maris… Ritus Orationis Maritimae in pluribus partibus… Lumian partes clavis interioribus repetit.

source: Suddenly, his heart skipped a beat as he made a connection.
target: Subito cor eius subsiluit, dum coniunctionem perceperit.

source: This was very similar to the Lent celebration in the Dariège mountains and the Spring Elf!
target: Hoc valde simile erat celebrationi Quadragesimae in montibus Dariège et Elfo Veris!

source: Though in reality, Lent celebration didn’t involve Ava’s head being chopped off or blood splattering, the dream scene left a deep impression on Lumian.
target: Quamquam in re, celebratio Quadragesimae non implicabat decollationem capitis Avae nec sanguinis dispersionem, scaena somniorum profundam impressionem in Lumian reliquit.

source: He instinctively associated the Lent celebration with something sinister and terrifying.
target: Instinctive, celebratio Quadragesimae aliquid sinistrum ac terribile coniunxit.

source: Doesn’t the sea prayer ritual here resemble the Lent celebration?
target: Nonne hic ritu orationis maritimae simile est celebrationi Quadragesimae?

source: Upon second thought, Lumian felt that the similarity didn’t explain the issue.
target: Secundo cogitato, Lumian sensit similitudinem quaestionem non explanare.

source: This was a common process in mysticism—the creation of a specific symbol to represent the sacrificial target to achieve the desired effect.
target: Hoc erat modus communis in mysticis—creatio signi specifici ad repraesentandum scopum sacrificii, quo effectus desideratus perveniret.

source: This was evident in many folklore rituals.
target: Hoc manifeste in multis rituibus popularibus apparuit.

source: “How are the Governor of the Sea and the Maidens of the Sea chosen?” Lumian asked curiously.
target: «Quomodo eliguntur Gubernator Maris et Puellae Maris?» quaesivit Lumian curiosus.

source: Could it be, like the Spring Elf, they’re elected by all the residents of Port Santa?
target: Forsitan, ut Elfo Vernali, ab omnibus incolis Porto Santa eliguntur?

source: Could one gain a high reputation and enjoy hidden benefits after the ritual?
target: Num quis famam praeclaram adipisci atque beneficia occulta post ritu frui possit?

source: Valerio took another drag from his cigar.
target: Valerio aliam tragam ex cigar suo traxit.

source: “They’re chosen by the committee members of the Fisheries Guild, the oldest guild in Port Santa.
target: «Eliguntur a membris commissionis Gildae Piscatoriae, veterissimae in Porto Santa,

source: They keep the specific criteria and whether they want to vote a secret.
target: qui retinent criteria specifica et utrum suffragium in secreto ferre velint.

source: Even the official members of the Fisheries Guild don’t know.”
target: Etiam membra officialia Gildae Piscatoriae nescunt.»

source: With that, the black‐market merchant grinned.
target: Hoc audito, mercator clandestinus subrisit.

source: “I also aim to become the Governor of the Sea.
target: «Etiam conor fieri Gubernator Maris.

source: They say it comes with many perks, but no one spills the details.”
target: Dicunt id cum multis commodis esse, sed nemo singula revelat.»

source: “How have the previous Governors of the Sea fared?” Lumian was more concerned about this matter.
target: «Quomodo se habuerunt praeteriti Gubernatores Maris?» quaesivit Lumian, hac re pluris sollicitus.

source: Valerio was taken aback.
target: Valerio obstupefactus est.

source: He thought for a moment before shaking his head.
target: Paulisper cogitavit antequam caput negaret.

source: “I’m not sure.
target: «Nescio.

source: Each Governor of the Sea serves only a one-year term.
target: Omnis Gubernator Maris solum unius anni mandatum habet.

source: Once they step down, they seem to be relocated.
target: Postquam secedunt, relocati esse videntur.

source: Anyway, they can’t stick around in Port Santa to avoid clashes with the new Governor.
target: Quocumque modo, in Porto Santa manere non possunt ut certaminibus cum novo Gubernatore vitent.

source: Heh heh, they’re surely offered hefty compensation and allowed to bring their families.”
target: Heh heh, certissime eis compensatio magna oblata est et familias suas adducere permittitur.

source: Relocated? Were they truly relocated, or did they face something else?
target: Relocati? Num revera relocati sunt, an aliam rem obvenerunt?

source: Lumian, drawing from past experiences, couldn’t help but think of something ominous and dreadful in the face of such a ritualistic folklore.
target: Lumian, ex praeteritis experimentis inspiratus, non potuit quin aliquid ominosum et terribile coram tali ritu populari cogitaret.

source: Regarding the Governor of the Sea’s subsequent experiences during the sea prayer ritual, it did sound peculiar.
target: De posteris experimentis Gubernatoris Maris in ritu orationis maritimae, res peculiares sonabant.

source: Lumian thought for a moment and, adopting the tone befitting his current guise, inquired, “What about the Maidens of the Sea?”
target: Lumian paulisper cogitavit et, more suae praesentis personae apto, interrogavit, «Quid de Puellis Maris?»

source: “They’re a hit among sea merchants, fishing company shareholders, and fishermen and sailors.
target: «Illae inter mercatores maritimos, socios societatis piscatoriae, piscatores et nautas summopere carae sunt,

source: Everyone wants to wed the Maidens of the Sea, a symbol of the sea’s blessing.
target: omnes velle nubere Puellis Maris, quae symbolum benedictionis maris sunt.

source: Explore various fishing villages, the Fisheries Guild, and the homes of sea merchants, and you’ll find many influential grandmothers who were once Maidens of the Sea.”
target: Explora varia vica piscatoria, Gildam Piscatoriam atque domos mercatorum maritimorum, et invenies multas avias notabiles, quae olim Puellae Maris fuerunt.»

source: Valerio’s face brimmed with envy, as if he too harbored dreams of marrying a Maiden of the Sea and becoming a true sea merchant.
target: Vultus Valerio invidia repletus erat, quasi ipse somnia haberet Puellam Maris in matrimonium ducendi et verum mercatorem maritimum fieri.

source: This mirrors the hidden benefits of being a Spring Elf…
target: Hoc imitatur beneficia occulta status Elfi Vernalis…

source: Lumian suppressed the urge to raise his right hand and stroke his chin.
target: Lumian impetum reprimit ne dextram manum tolleret et mentum suum foveret.

source: Knowing when to cease, he refrained from pressing further.
target: Sciente quando desinendum esset, amplius instare non voluit.

source: After depositing 50 gold risot, he exited Valerio’s illegal casino with Lugano.
target: Postquam 50 risot aureos deposuit, exiit ex cassino illicitō Valerio cum Lugano.

source: Ludwig didn’t come with them.
target: Ludwig non venit cum illis.

source: Instead, he was stationed in a nearby family restaurant equipped with a children’s entertainment facility, overseen by specialized caretakers and a provided meal.
target: Sed constitutus erat in caupona familiae proxima, quae cum facilitate ludicra puerorum instructa erat, a curatoribus peritis administrata et cum mensa provisa.

source: In Feynapotter, numerous industries supported parents in raising children and alleviating stress.
target: In Feynapotter, innumerabiles industriae parentes adiuverunt in liberorum educandis et sollicitudinem levandam.

source: Intis and other countries lacked such facilities, and even if they existed, they were accessible only to the elite.
target: Intis aliisque nationibus talia instituta defuerunt, et etiam, si exsisterent, solum ad optimos accedebant.

source: Trier, catacombs.
target: Trier, catacumbae.

source: Franca and Jenna descended to the third level with their flickering white candles.
target: Franca et Jenna ad gradum tertium descendere coeperunt cum candelis albis micantibus.

source: Feeling a bit less stifled, Franca turned her head and inquired, “What’s the name of the tomb we’re after?”
target: Sentiente paulo minus oppressa, Franca caput vertit et interrogavit, «Quid est nomen sepulcri quem quaerimus?»

source: Jenna didn’t hesitate and replied, “The Thorn and Shieldwall Tomb.”
target: Jenna non dubitavit et respondit, «Sepulcrum Spinae et Muri Scutarii.»
